
{{alias}}( λ )
    Returns the median of a geometric distribution with shape parameter `λ`.

    If `lambda <= 0`, the function returns `NaN`.

    Parameters
    ----------
    λ: number
        Shape parameter.

    Returns
    -------
    out: integer
        Median.

    Examples
    --------
    > var v = {{alias}}( 0.1 )
    6
    > v = {{alias}}( 1.5 )
    0

    See Also
    --------
